raw.product_description: The system comprises three layers: an Observe Layer (Layer 1) with lightweight desktop sensors capturing application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation; an Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) acting as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value, and work "drift"; and an Execution Layer (Layer 3), an "Agent Factory" that generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. It leverages existing foundation models and focuses on building a "Work Graph" to identify inefficiencies and apply AI assistance.
